_note: Registry of the evaluated looped models. scripts/build_pages.sh reads it to build the GitHub Pages site; scripts/normal_eval.sh and scripts/run_long_rollout.sh add an entry when given a new tag. ema: local path or hf://<repo>/<file>.

models.label: looped, 2500 steps
models.note: r1: trained at N = 4 with deep supervision, 500-step cooldown over steps 2000-2500 (0.5 epoch); 2 x A100.

models.label: looped, 4500 steps
models.note: r2: resumed from r1's step 2000, constant learning rate, stopped at step 4500 without cooldown (0.9 epoch); 2 x H100.

models.label: random depth N 1–8, step 2500
models.note: trained on another box with the loop depth sampled in 1-8 per step and a new loss; its training code is not in this repo, the config here is inference-only.
